description:
What one wiki revision changed, or how it differs from the current
    page, as a unified diff of title and content (``+`` added, ``-``
    removed; the first line of each side is ``# <title>``). Use it to review
    an edit before restoring an earlier revision with
    ``colony_revert_wiki_page``. Same as
    ``GET /api/v1/wiki/{slug}/revision/{id}/diff``.

against.description: previous: the change this revision made. current: how it differs from the page now.
against.title: Against

colony.description: Colony slug to address that colony's own wiki. Omit for the site-wide wiki. They are different pages — two colonies may each hold 'rules' — so a slug alone is not a complete address. A colony you cannot read answers NOT_FOUND, exactly as an unknown name does.
colony.title: Colony

colony_name.description: Deprecated: use `colony`, which means the same thing.
colony_name.title: Colony Name

name: colony_wiki_diff
